+package pr4review
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"sync"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/entireio/go-nuts/jsconsumer"
+	natsserver "github.com/nats-io/nats-server/v2/server"
+	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
+	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go/jetstream"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
+)
+
+func TestPrefetchedMessagesCanExpireBeforeCallback(t *testing.T) {
+	s, err := natsserver.NewServer(&natsserver.Options{Host: "127.0.0.1", Port: -1, NoLog: true, NoSigs: true, JetStream: true, StoreDir: t.TempDir()})
+	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
+	go s.Start()
+	if !s.ReadyForConnections(10 * time.Second) { t.Fatal("server not ready") }
+	defer s.Shutdown()
+
+	nc, err := nats.Connect(s.ClientURL())
+	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
+	defer nc.Close()
+	js, err := jetstream.New(nc)
+	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	defer cancel()
+	_, err = js.CreateStream(ctx, jetstream.StreamConfig{Name: "s", Subjects: []string{"events"}})
+	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
+
+	cfg := jsconsumer.Config{Stream: "s", Durable: "d", FilterSubject: "events", AckWait: 60 * time.Millisecond, MaxDeliver: 5, KeepInProgress: true}
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	var deliveries []string
+	run, err := jsconsumer.Start(ctx, nc, cfg, func(msg jetstream.Msg) {
+		jsconsumer.Process(ctx, msg, cfg, func(b []byte) (string, error) { return string(b), nil }, func(_ context.Context, _ trace.Span, m jetstream.Msg, body string) {
+			meta, _ := m.Metadata()
+			mu.Lock()
+			deliveries = append(deliveries, body+":"+string(rune('0'+meta.NumDelivered)))
+			mu.Unlock()
+			if body == "slow" && meta.NumDelivered == 1 { time.Sleep(220 * time.Millisecond) }
+			_ = m.Ack()
+		}, nil)
+	})
+	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
+	defer run.Stop()
+	if _, err = js.Publish(ctx, "events", []byte("slow")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
+	if _, err = js.Publish(ctx, "events", []byte("fast")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
+	time.Sleep(600 * time.Millisecond)
+	mu.Lock()
+	got := append([]string(nil), deliveries...)
+	mu.Unlock()
+	t.Logf("deliveries: %v", got)
+	if len(got) <= 2 { t.Skip("timing did not expose prefetch redelivery") }
+}
*** End Patch";
